runs.user_query: Summarize the Phase 3 clinical trial results for Drug X in oncology
runs.input: Summarize Phase 3 trial results for Drug X for Medical Affairs team, oncology indication
runs.output:
Key Insights: Drug X demonstrated 45% reduction in primary endpoint (PFS) vs standard of care.
Section 1: Overview - Phase 3 randomized double-blind trial enrolled 1,247 patients across 87 sites.
Section 2: Efficacy - Primary endpoint of progression-free survival met with HR=0.55 (95% CI: 0.45-0.67), p<0.0001. Median PFS 14.2 months vs 7.8 months for control.
Section 3: Safety - Grade 3+ adverse events in 28% of treatment arm vs 22% control. Most common: neutropenia (12%), fatigue (8%).
Section 4: Medical Affairs CCG - Indication: NSCLC 2L+ | Evidence: Phase 3 PROFILE-301 | Recommendation: Add to formulary for biomarker-positive patients.
Section 5: Development Summary - Regulatory submission planned Q3 2026. Companion diagnostic in parallel review.
Section 6: Development CCG - Manufacturing scale-up complete; supply readiness Q4 2026.
Section 7: Confidence - HIGH for primary efficacy (mature Phase 3 data, n=1247). MEDIUM for subgroup analyses (smaller sample sizes). LOW for long-term OS (data not yet mature).
Filters confirmed: Indication=Oncology, Phase=3, Role=Medical Affairs, Region=US, Year=2026.

runs.user_query: What is the safety profile of Drug Y in cardiovascular patients?
runs.input: Provide safety profile summary of Drug Y for cardiovascular indication, Medical Affairs view
runs.output:
Key Insights: Drug Y shows favorable cardiovascular safety with manageable adverse event profile.
Section 1: Overview - Pooled safety data from 3 Phase 3 trials, 2,840 patients, mean exposure 18 months.
Section 2: Efficacy - Secondary safety endpoints: 32% reduction in MACE composite vs placebo.
Section 3: Safety - Serious AE rate 8.4% (treatment) vs 7.9% (placebo). No QT prolongation signal.
Section 4: Medical Affairs CCG - Indication: HF with reduced EF | Evidence: COMPASS-HF Phase 3 | Recommendation: Monitor renal function quarterly; safe for elderly subgroup.
Section 5: Development Summary - Label expansion to HFpEF in planning.
Section 6: Development CCG - Real-world evidence study launching Q2 2026.
Section 7: Confidence - HIGH for primary safety endpoints (large pooled dataset). MEDIUM for rare events (<1% incidence). LOW for pediatric population (no data).
Filters confirmed: Indication=Cardiology, Phase=3, Role=Medical Affairs, Region=Global, Year=2026.

runs.user_query: Long-term efficacy data for Drug A in diabetes
runs.input: 5-year follow-up efficacy for Drug A in type 2 diabetes
runs.output:
Key Insights: Drug A maintains glycemic control and cardiovascular benefits at 5-year follow-up.
Section 1: Overview - Open-label extension of LEADER-2 trial; 1,580 patients completed 5 years.
Section 2: Efficacy - Sustained HbA1c reduction of -1.2% from baseline. 22% reduction in 3-point MACE.
Section 3: Safety - No new safety signals. Hypoglycemia rate stable at 4.1/100 patient-years.
Section 4: Medical Affairs CCG - Indication: T2DM with CV risk | Evidence: LEADER-2 OLE | Recommendation: First-line for patients with established CVD.
Section 5: Development Summary - Label update submitted; pediatric trial Phase 3 enrolling.
Section 6: Development CCG - Combination product with metformin in Phase 2.
Section 7: Confidence - HIGH for adult efficacy/safety (5-year data, n=1580). MEDIUM for combination therapy outcomes. LOW for pediatric extrapolation.
Filters confirmed: Indication=Endocrinology, Phase=Extension, Role=Medical Affairs, Region=Global, Year=2026.
